name: Certification Reassignment (Legacy)
description: Notifies a reviewer when they have been reassigned identities from an existing certification.
subject: Identities reassigned to you for certification review
body:
Certification reassignment

Dear ${user.name},

${requesterName} has assigned ${numNewIdentities} #if(${numNewIdentities} == 1) user #{else} users #{end} to you for review in a certification.

Reason for reassignment
${description}

Review deadline
You have until $spTools.formatDate($certification.expiration,3,0) to review and either approve, change, or revoke access for these users.

Review the certification

Thank you for completing this review in Identity Security Cloud.
